title: SANParks rest camps & lodges
description: Official reservations for South African National Parks — rest camps, bungalows, and wilderness camps across Kruger, Addo, Garden Route, and more.
planningTip: Peak season (June–July, December) fills months ahead — book Kruger camps early or consider private concessions on park borders.

title: Namibia Wildlife Resorts
description: Government-run camps and lodges inside Namibia's flagship parks — Etosha waterholes, Sesriem (Sossusvlei gateway), and coastal reserves.
planningTip: July–October dry season is busiest at Etosha — reserve waterhole camps well in advance.

title: Zambia National Parks accommodation
description: Park fees and lodge guidance for Zambia's major reserves — South Luangwa walking safaris, Kafue bushcamps, and Lower Zambezi canoe trails.
planningTip: Many Luangwa lodges are outside the park gate — compare operator websites with park entry fees separately.

title: Zimbabwe Parks & Wildlife Authority
description: Official park accommodation and fee information for Hwange, Mana Pools, Matobo, and Victoria Falls National Park.
planningTip: Victoria Falls and some park fees are often paid in USD cash — carry small notes for gates.

title: ANAC conservation area permits
description: National Administration of Conservation Areas — permits and lodge guidance for Gorongosa, Bazaruto Archipelago, and mainland reserves.
planningTip: Island lodges in Bazaruto often arrange boat transfers — confirm visa status before travel.

title: Malawi Department of National Parks
description: Park fees and accommodation guidance for Liwonde, Nyika Plateau, and Lake Malawi National Park campsites.
planningTip: Lake Malawi park fees and Liwonde boat safaris are often arranged through lodges on arrival.

title: Lesotho nature reserves & parks
description: Forestry and park accommodation in the Kingdom in the Sky — high-altitude reserves and Sani Pass gateway lodges.
planningTip: Entry is almost always via South Africa — confirm your SA visa allows re-entry after visiting Lesotho.

title: Big Game Parks reserves
description: Central booking for Eswatini's flagship reserves — Hlane Royal National Park, Mkhaya rhino sanctuary, and Mlilwane Wildlife Sanctuary.
planningTip: Hlane and Mkhaya are run by Big Game Parks — book through their Ezulwini office for best availability.

title: Botswana park & lodge planning
description: Official guidance on park fees, mobile safaris, and lodge booking in the Okavango Delta and Chobe — most camps book through Maun and Kasane operators.
planningTip: Okavango fly-in camps and Moremi public camps have limited sites — compare Maun operators vs mobile safari outfits.

title: South Africa Tourism — plan your trip
description: Official destination portal with links to provincial tourism boards, registered guides, and activity providers across all nine provinces.
planningTip: For Kruger, compare SANParks self-drive with private reserve operators on the park boundary — different rules and costs.

title: Namibia Tourism Board
description: Official operator and activity directory — self-drive routes, community conservancy lodges, and licensed safari guides.
planningTip: Community conservancies in Damaraland and Kaokoland offer unique stays — book through conservancy offices or NTB-listed operators.

title: Botswana Tourism — licensed operators
description: Official directory of licensed safari operators, Delta camps, and Chobe River cruise providers — book directly with registered companies.
planningTip: Verify operator registration with Botswana Tourism before paying deposits — Okavango fly-in camps require advance booking.

title: Zambia Tourism Agency
description: Official activity and operator listings — Victoria Falls adventures, South Luangwa walking safari specialists, and Lower Zambezi canoe operators.
planningTip: KAZA UniVisa (USD 50) covers Zambia and Zimbabwe for Victoria Falls circuits — confirm eligibility for your passport.

title: Zimbabwe Tourism Authority
description: Registered tour operators and activity providers — Victoria Falls rafting and helicopter flights, Hwange safari operators, Mana Pools canoe safaris.
planningTip: Mana Pools walking safaris require licensed guides — book through ZTA-listed operators with park permits.

title: Visit Mozambique — tours & diving
region: Maputo, Tofo, Bazaruto, Ilha de Moçambique
description: Official tourism portal with registered operators — Tofo whale shark diving, Bazaruto island transfers, and Maputo cultural walking tours.
planningTip: Most visitors need a visa — apply via the e-visa portal before travel when possible.

title: Malawi Tourism — community & lake
description: Licensed operators for Lake Malawi kayaking, Liwonde boat safaris, Mount Mulanje trekking guides, and community homestay programmes.
planningTip: Community tourism villages around Cape Maclear and Nkhata Bay offer homestays — book through official Malawi Tourism listings.

title: Visit Lesotho — pony trekking & adventure
description: Registered pony trekking outfits, Sani Pass 4x4 guides, and Malealea community lodge operators in the Kingdom in the Sky.
planningTip: Sani Pass requires a 4x4 and experienced driver — several licensed operators run return trips from Underberg (South Africa).

title: Eswatini Tourism — culture & wildlife
description: Official operator directory — Mantenga Cultural Village tours, Hlane game drives, and craft market guides in the Ezulwini Valley.
planningTip: Time your visit with the Umhlanga Reed Dance (August–September) or Incwala ceremony for unique cultural experiences.
